title: Managed Database: external retention allocation — assessment outcome
content:
## Assessment basis
Managed Database external retention allocation uses the following assessment outcome basis. Multiply the external protected capacity by the nonnegative excess of allocation horizon over native included days, divide by that horizon, and round half-up to six decimal GB-month places once at the final outcome. If the horizon equals native included days the external allocation is zero.

## Hypothetical calculation
Hypothetical inputs: protected capacity is 120 GB-month, the allocation horizon is 30 days and native inclusion is 10 days. The excess is 20 days. Multiplying 120 by 20 and dividing by 30 gives 80.000000 GB-month. If both durations are 10 days, the excess and allocation are zero.
